note: Write-only acknowledge register of the HomeVent ventilation unit. Hoval's own Modbus list documents the register (reg 28939, listed there as LIST 'Quittierung') but leaves the values implicit; this entry records the measured usage. Exposed by the esp_canbus HV presets as the 'Acknowledge filter maintenance' button (id HV_0_0_21054_ack, single-byte write): value 7 acknowledges filter maintenance (clears the maintenance message), value 8 acknowledges cleaning (clears the cleaning message; not yet exposed by esp_canbus). SET only -- no GET answer.
